picks.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interview, internal AI tool in $6.3 billion breach
picks.summary: Binance s incident report said hackers used a fake job interview and an internal AI tool to gain access to systems involved in the theft.

picks.title: AI chip smugglers exploit trade control loophole to bring banned HBM from South Korea into China — expensive memory chips packaged with cheap, unsanctioned processors to become legal exports
picks.summary: Customs authorities only check the performance specifications of a server s processors, allowing smugglers to attach high-end memory chips to low-end processors and ship them into China.

picks.title: Liquid Network restores full bitcoin backing following $320 million exploit
picks.summary: Liquid Network said its bitcoin reserves are back to full backing after September s exploit, with Blockstream providing the funds.

picks.title: Liquid Network Restores Full Bitcoin Backing Two Months After $320M Exploit
picks.summary: Blockstream CEO Adam Back said the sidechain s defenses have been hardened, and warned developers not to trust AI-suggested fixes blindly.

picks.title: Liquid’s bitcoin IOUs are fully backed again after a $320 million exploit

picks.summary: Hackers who breached Harvard University s Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025 stole data linked to more than 850,000 unique email addresses, according to breach notification service Have I Been Pwned. [...]

picks.title: CZ calls for crypto security alliance as AI-driven attacks accelerate after Binance hack
picks.summary: In his first interview since the Binance hack, Changpeng Zhao says AI is accelerating cyberattacks and calls for industry security alliance.

picks.title: Brazil s Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
picks.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won t pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.
